name: Change Mail Page
description: Provides a separate page for users to change their email address.
project_description: Change Mail Page provides a dedicated page for users to change their email address, separate from the full account-edit form. It adds a 'Change Email' local task (tab) to user profiles, hides the email field from the default user edit form for non-administrators, and drives all email changes through a small standalone form that requires the account's current password. Two routes are provided: /user/change-mail (redirects the logged-in user to their own form) and /user/{user}/change-mail (the form itself, gated by core's user.update entity access). Administrators keep the ability to edit email on the standard user form. Works on Drupal 10 and 11 and has no dependencies beyond core.
